problem.title: Receivables follow-up is easily scattered.
problem.body: Invoices spread across files and software, due dates spotted late, reminders handled one by one: when information is scattered, it becomes harder to see what is expected and which actions should come first.
cards: Invoices and customer information spread across several tools.
Manual follow-ups without a centralized history.

solution.intro: The initial VERQIA PILOT scope is organized around four functions: centralize, prioritize, follow up and record.
solution.indexLabel: Four functions envisioned for VERQIA PILOT

centralize.title: Centralize
centralize.body: Find invoices, clients and due dates in one place.
centralize.problem: Customer information, invoices and due dates are spread across different places.
centralize.action: The initial scope plans to bring them together in one follow-up space.

understand.title: Prioritize
understand.body: Analyze collections and situations that may need attention.
understand.problem: It is not always clear which receivable to handle first.
understand.action: Identify overdue invoices, approaching due dates and actions to take.
understand.value: Organize collection work around visible priorities.

anticipate.title: Follow up
anticipate.problem: Follow-ups are often repetitive and handled one at a time.
anticipate.action: Structure follow-up and prepare message templates; automated sending is not announced.
anticipate.value: Use a more consistent and traceable follow-up approach.

decide.title: Track
decide.body: Organize actions with the VERQIA decision engine.
decide.problem: Replies, payment promises and payments can get lost across scattered exchanges.
decide.action: Record replies, promises to pay and payments entered in the system.
decide.value: Keep a history to better observe collections over time.

solution.outcomesTitle: What this approach aims to improve
solution.outcomesIntro: These are expected benefits to measure during initial pilots; no gain is guaranteed at this stage.
outcomes: Reduce time spent on repetitive follow-ups.
Improve visibility into amounts still due.
Base decisions on the information available.
Observe changes in receivables and collections.

free.question: Is VERQIA available yet?
free.answer: No. The institutional deck places the project in the problem-validation stage. The website mock-up is conceptual; no receivables-management service is presented as operational.

difference.question: What is the difference between FREE and STARTER?
difference.answer: FREE describes a discovery space under consideration. STARTER corresponds to the envisioned initial operational scope. These plans and their features are not presented as available today.

business.question: Why choose BUSINESS?
business.answer: Forecasts, risk analysis and the decision engine are envisioned evolutions. They are not presented as operational features.

accounting.question: Does VERQIA replace accounting software?
accounting.answer: No. VERQIA PILOT is designed as a specialized layer that complements existing tools. No technical integration with those tools is announced as available.

change.question: Can I change plans?
change.answer: Subscriptions are not being marketed yet. Terms and plan-change conditions still need to be defined.

sector.question: Is VERQIA suitable for my industry?

aboutPage.title: Behind VERQIA, one ambition: make receivables management more intelligent.
aboutPage.description: We are building a new approach to receivables monitoring and collections management, so businesses can better organize their collection cycle.

founder.title: A word from the founder
founder.photoCaption: Photograph supplied for the institutional presentation.
founder.paragraphOne: VERQIA was born from a conviction: businesses should be able to better master the journey between an invoice and its collection.
founder.paragraphTwo: We set out to design a solution that does more than track invoices: it helps businesses organize their actions, better understand their receivables and improve their visibility over expected collections.
founder.paragraphThree: Our ambition is to make collections management more accessible, more structured and more relevant for small and medium-sized businesses.
founder.paragraphFour: VERQIA is an adventure built around a vision: give businesses the means to manage their cash flow with more method and intelligence.
founder.quote: We do not want to create software that businesses find interesting. We want to create a tool whose financial value they can see and that they choose to pay for every month.
founder.signaturePending: Founder name and title to be completed before publication.
